messages.subject: [genoPlotR-help] GenoplotR
messages.body_plain:
Dear Gustavo,

Thank you for your interest in genoPlotR.
In read_mauve_backbone, there is an option, common_blocks_only, that is TRUE by default, that discards non-common blocks. Setting it to FALSE should fix your problem. Let me know if it doesn't work...

The reason why it is TRUE by default is that mauve backbone files can be huge and I wanted to limit the size of the objects read by genoPlotR.

HTH,

Lionel

On 8 Mar 2012, at 18:59 , Gustavo Cerqueira wrote:

> Dear Lionel,
> 
> Thanks for the time spent designing GenoplotR. It is a very nice and useful tool for comparative genomics.
> 
> We are having an issue when display Mauve alignments. It seems that only blocks of the backbones with similarity across all genomes are being shown (projections and rainbow plot).
> I mean... All records in Mauve backbbone file with 0 in any of the columns are not being shown. Is this the usual behavior? 
> 
> Thank you very much. Best regards,
>
